claim.text: Is the statement described in this narrative hearsay under FRE 801(c)?

arguments.text: The narrative describes Christopher's temperament ('often moody and had a large temper') rather than an out-of-court assertion. Under FRE 801(c), hearsay requires a 'statement,' defined as an oral or written assertion. Because the evidence is circumstantial or direct evidence of state of mind/character and lacks an assertion, it cannot be hearsay.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c) definition of hearsay requires an out-of-court statement (assertion).
